0.comment: Dr. Edith: Vennessa and the Great Oak
0.content: Edith retells the popular legend: Vennessa grew up enslaved, rose against the oppressive aristocrats, secured freedom for Mondstadt and ascended to Celestia, becoming a goddess who protects the nation. The oak at Windrise is said to have grown in the year she left. Edith gives the Traveler The Legend of Vennessa, Vol. 1, and says she has met countless stories and ballads about the tree.
